title: Visual Studio April Update: Cloud Agent Integration
description: April 2026 update centers on agentic workflows: cloud agent sessions launch directly from IDE, custom agents gain user-level support in %USERPROFILE%/.github/agents/, new Debugger agent validates fixes against live runtime behavior, customizable keyboard shortcuts, new chat history panel, and C++ code editing tools now generally available.

title: Week 17 Updates: UltraReview Research Preview
description: /ultrareview opens as a research preview, automatic session recaps when returning to terminal, custom color themes for plugins, redesigned web version with sessions sidebar and drag-and-drop layout, Vim visual mode support, hooks can call MCP tools, and performance improvements including 67% faster /resume on large sessions.

title: Devin 2.2 Release
description: Desktop support enabled by default for new users, existing users can enable through Settings, enhanced session management indicating 'Action Required' state, minor bug fixes and polish.

title: Version 2.1.128: Performance and UX Improvements
description: Bare /color picks random session color, /mcp shows tool count and flags empty servers, --plugin-dir accepts .zip archives, --channels works with console authentication, subprocesses no longer inherit OTEL environment variables, and multiple fixes for focus mode, drag-and-drop, and terminal rendering.

title: Version 2.1.126: Enhanced Plugin System and MCP Improvements
description: /model picker now lists models from gateway's /v1/models endpoint, added claude project purge command, --dangerously-skip-permissions bypasses prompts, claude auth login accepts OAuth code pasted in terminal, auto mode spinner turns red on permission stall, and PowerShell tool progressively rolling out on Windows.

title: Version 2.1.122: Enhanced Effort Levels and Tool Deferral
description: Added ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER environment variable, pasting PR URL into /resume finds the session that created it, /mcp shows claude.ai connectors hidden by duplicate servers, and OpenTelemetry now includes numeric attributes and at_mention log events.

title: Version 2.1.121: Performance and Memory Improvements
description: Added alwaysLoad option to MCP server config, claude plugin prune command, type-to-filter search box for /skills, fullscreen mode improvements, and fixed unbounded memory growth when processing many images, /resume crashing on large sessions, and Bash tool becoming unusable when directory is deleted.

title: Version 2.1.120: PowerShell Tool and Enhanced CLI
description: Windows: Git for Windows no longer required (PowerShell used as shell), added claude ultrareview subcommand for non-interactive code review, Skills can reference CLAUDE_EFFORT variable, and Set AI_AGENT environment variable for subprocesses so gh can attribute traffic to Claude Code.

title: Version 2.1.119: Config Persistence and Pruning
description: /config settings now persist to ~/.claude/settings.json and participate in project/local/policy override precedence, added prUrlTemplate setting, CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD environment variable, --from-pr accepts GitLab MR and Bitbucket PR URLs, and hooks now include duration_ms in PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure inputs.

title: Version 2.1.118: Custom Themes and MCP Tool Invocations
description: Added vim visual mode (v) and visual-line mode (V), merged /cost and /stats into /usage, create and switch between named custom themes from /theme, hooks can now invoke MCP tools directly via type: mcp_tool, and added DISABLE_UPDATES env var to block all update paths.

title: Aider v0.86.0: GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models, added support for Grok-4 via xai/grok-4 and openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 model names, added support for gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 model, improved /clear and /undo commands, fixed settings replacement issue, and bumped dependencies to litellm 1.75.0.

title: Windsurf 2.0: Agent Command Center and Devin Integration
description: Introducing Windsurf 2.0 with the Agent Command Center, enabling local and cloud agents to work together. Features include Devin integration in Windsurf, enhanced collaborative AI capabilities, and improved agentic workflows for shipping code faster.

title: Team Marketplace Updates
description: Team marketplace enhancements for sharing custom extensions and tools across teams.

title: Cursor Security Review
description: Security enhancements and review updates for the Cursor platform.

title: Build Programmatic Agents with the Cursor SDK
description: Introduction of the Cursor SDK for building programmatic agents, enabling developers to create custom agents and automate workflows.

title: Version 3.2: Multitask, Worktrees, and Multi-root Workspaces
description: Cursor 3.2 release with multitask capabilities, git worktrees support, and multi-root workspace functionality for working with multiple codebases simultaneously.

title: Version v0.42.0-nightly.20260504
description: Nightly release with workspace trust documentation updates, ACP client modularization, test fixes, /exit --delete flag for session deletion, @ mention gemini robot support, API timeout reduction to 60s with retries, InvalidStream event handling, GitHub App token for CI, logPrompts flag respect, API key validation fixes, exit_plan_mode shell protection, GrepTool case-sensitivity fixes, Gemma setup guide, non-https proxy URL support, productivity optimizations, ACP prompt turn processing delegation, platform-specific undo/redo for WSL, byte length limits for stdin, shell tool header wrapping, voice mode UI updates, /commands list subcommand, extension delete alias, and numerous bug fixes and improvements.

title: Version v0.42.0-nightly.20260429
description: Nightly release with transient error policy updates, time-series metric analysis bot, non-string model flag resolution handling, ENOTDIR error messages, ACP stdout pollution prevention, boolean/number casting for env vars in settings.json, DevTools activity logger Request header preservation, automatic update channel switching prevention, Node arguments via NODE_OPTIONS for SEA support, DECKPAM keypad Enter sequence handling, plan-mode session retention documentation, subagent oauth field support, and extension-backed MCP client disconnection fixes.

title: Version v0.41.0-preview.0
description: Preview release featuring secure .env loading with workspace trust in headless mode, fatal hard-crash fix for loop detection via AbortError, shell command validation with core tools allowlist, Gemma 4 model support (experimental), slow boot fix via asynchronous experiments/quota fetching, real-time voice mode with cloud and local backends, auto-memory scratchpad persistence for skill extraction, custom theme text schema fixes, manual update command on failure, ContextManager and AgentChatHistory integration, sandbox proxy cleanup, JetBrains alternate buffer warning logic, MCP ping optional in list command, Cloud Shell GCA auth error messages, manual session UUID via CLI, plan-mode session state reset on /clear, and numerous other fixes and enhancements.

title: Version 0.128.0
description: Major release adding persisted /goal workflows with app-server APIs, model tools, runtime continuation, and TUI controls. Features include codex update command, configurable TUI keymaps, plan-mode nudges, action-required terminal titles, active-turn /statusline and /title edits, expanded permission profiles with built-in defaults, sandbox CLI profile selection, improved plugin workflows with marketplace installation, external agent session import, MultiAgentV2 configuration improvements, resume/interruption fixes, TUI reliability improvements, managed network hardening, Windows sandbox and PTY fixes, Bedrock model support fixes, and MCP/plugin edge case handling.
